sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.narrative, t2.narrative, t3.narrative, t4.given, t4.surname FROM visits v JOIN subjects t4 ON v.person=t4.person JOIN therapy_schedule t1 ON t1.visit=v.identifier JOIN operations t2 ON t2.visit=v.identifier JOIN drugs t3 ON t3.visit=v.identifier WHERE v.identifier='6f2e3935-b203-493e-a9c0-f23e847b9798'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t2.day - t1.natal_day BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN t2.amount ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.day - t1.natal_day BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN t2.person END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t2.day - t1.natal_day BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN t2.amount ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.day - t1.natal_day BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN t2.person END) FROM subjects t1 JOIN readings t2 ON t1.person=t2.person WHERE t2.narrative='Glucose'
SELECT t2.narrative FROM subjects t1 JOIN diagnoses t2 ON t1.person=t2.person WHERE t1.title='Mrs.' AND t1.given='Joye' AND t1.surname='Homenick' AND substr(t2.onset,1,4)='2017'

SELECT MAX(t2.day) FROM subjects t1 JOIN shots t2 ON t1.person=t2.person WHERE t1.title='Mrs.' AND t1.given='Joye' AND t1.surname='Homenick' AND t2.narrative='Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.person), t2.narrative FROM visits t1 JOIN therapy_schedule t2 ON t1.person=t2.person WHERE t1.cause_narrative='Second degree burn' AND t2.cause_narrative='Second degree burn' GROUP BY t2.narrative
SELECT DISTINCT t1.narrative FROM drugs t1 JOIN subjects t2 ON t1.person=t2.person WHERE t2.given='Joye' AND t2.surname='Homenick'
SELECT DISTINCT t1.identifier FROM therapy_schedule t1 JOIN subjects t2 ON t1.person=t2.person WHERE t2.origin='Pembroke MA US'

SELECT AVG((julianday(COALESCE(t1.expiry_day, substr(datetime('now'),1,10))) - julianday(t1.natal_day))/365) FROM subjects t1 JOIN diagnoses t2 ON t1.person=t2.person WHERE t1.sex='M' AND t2.narrative='Hypertension'
